The search · Google Maps, 10 November 2026

Near the top of the list. Behind on the stars.

We searched "lodges in Hluhluwe" on Google Maps. After two paid ads, Leopard Walk is the second lodge on the list, right after Hluhluwe River Lodge. That part is working.

But a traveller doesn't stop at the position. They compare stars. Six of the eight other places on that screen show 4.5 or higher. Leopard Walk shows 4.3.

The problem · one tap on Google Maps

Tap "4.5+" and Leopard Walk disappears.

Google Maps lets travellers filter places to stay by guest rating, all the way up to 4.5+. A couple planning a special trip, a honeymoon or an anniversary, is exactly the guest who taps 4.5+.

The moment they do, Leopard Walk drops off the list and the lodges around you stay on it. Nothing is wrong with the stay. From 4.3 on 201 reviews, it takes roughly 40 to 75 new five-star reviews to show 4.5. Your guests already write reviews like that. Most of them are just never asked on Google.

How it works · when a stay wasn't perfect

An unhappy guest reaches you before they reach Google.

A guest who rates their stay 3 or lower gets a private message asking what went wrong. You hear about it straight away, and can put it right while it's still fresh.

Every guest is still sent the Google link, because Google doesn't allow review invitations to go only to happy guests. What changes is that you hear about the problem first, privately, and get the chance to fix it.

Guests' names are blurred to protect their privacy.

WhatsApp · TO Strand, Port Edward
How it works · already running at Dot Com Restaurant

Answered in a minute. Handed to you when it matters.

A guest asks a simple question on WhatsApp and gets the answer straight away. When they ask for something only a person can decide, it is handed over, and the guest is told when to expect a reply.

At Leopard Walk, you're out on a drive or serving dinner when a couple asks about the Jacuzzi suites, the conservation levy or directions from Hluhluwe. They get the answer in a minute, and every booking comes to you. You can step into any chat yourself, whenever you want to.

How the first month runs

Reviews live in week one. About an hour of your time.

Day 1

Kickoff

An hour together. You give us access to Google, WhatsApp and NightsBridge, and tell us how the lodge likes to sound.

Week 1

Asked and answered

Review requests switched on after every checkout, and the WhatsApp assistant answering guests, evenings included.

Week 2

Every review replied

Google replies running in your voice. Booking.com, Tripadvisor and LekkeSlaap replies written for you to post.

Weeks 3 to 4

Tuned

The assistant's answers checked against real guest questions, and a half-hour call to walk you through everything.

Fair questions

You stay in control of your lodge.

Your voice
A bot talking to my guests?

It only answers facts you've approved: suites, rates, meal plans, directions. Bookings, special requests and complaints always come to you. If you'd like to see Google replies before they go out, we send them to you to approve first.

Your guests
What about their details?

Guest details are used only to send your review request after checkout. They are never shared, sold or used for anything else, and they stay with the lodge.

Your call
What if it doesn't work for us?

Month to month, 30 days' notice, no long contract. Everything we set up stays yours. And since every guest still gets the Google link, nothing about your reviews is ever filtered.
